author: wilson-seok
title: ARM64 cross-compilation build fails with cc1plus: not a PCH file (invalid-pch) in openvino_reference
signature: cc1plus error cmake_pch hxx gch not a pch file werror invalid pch|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: cc1plus errors with 'not a PCH file' (-Werror=invalid-pch) while compiling src/core/reference sources during the 'CMake configure, build and install - OpenVINO JS API' step, aborting the ninja build.

key_errors: cc1plus: error: /__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/openvino_build/src/core/reference/CMakeFiles/openvino_reference.dir/cmake_pch.hxx.gch: not a PCH file [-Werror=invalid-pch]
cc1plus: all warnings being treated as errors
root_cause: The 'Cmake build - OpenVINO' step (step 13) completes successfully and produces a valid cmake_pch.hxx.gch for openvino_reference. Later, the 'CMake configure, build and install - OpenVINO JS API' step (step 26) re-runs CMake configure/build against the same source tree/build directory used for the native build, which re-triggers compilation of openvino_reference translation units (e.g. convert.cpp, depth_to_space.cpp, einsum.cpp) under the JS API's ninja invocation. Because the previous .gch artifact is being concurrently regenerated or was only partially written/invalidated by the JS configure step re-touching the PCH header, cc1plus finds the .gch file present but not a valid precompiled header, and -Werror=invalid-pch promotes this to a hard build failure. This is the same recurring infrastructure/build-orchestration defect already tracked under signature 5b4b1e6917a69856 (4 prior occurrences across unrelated PRs #38483, #38380, #38393, #37942), confirming it is unrelated to the current PR's GPU SDPA changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the exact ARM64 cross-compilation container/build-cache state from CI; not reliably reproducible in a local single-step build. To approximate: build openvino natively, then immediately re-run a second CMake configure+build targeting the OpenVINO JS API bindings against the same openvino_build directory while the PCH for src/core/reference is being regenerated.
recommended_actions: Isolate the JS API CMake configure/build step to use its own build directory (or force a clean PCH regeneration) instead of reusing the native build's openvino_build directory to avoid racing on cmake_pch.hxx.gch.

Consider disabling precompiled headers (CMAKE_DISABLE_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS / ENABLE_PCH=OFF) for the ARM64 cross-compilation JS API build step, or add a dependency so the JS API build does not re-touch openvino_reference's PCH after the main build already populated it.
Add a rerun/retry (already covered by this pattern's rerun_search_string) for CI Doctor's automated remediation while the root build-orchestration fix is implemented.
Escalate to CI infra maintainers given this is the 5th recorded occurrence of this exact signature across unrelated PRs.
prevention_strategies: Ensure build steps that reuse the same CMake build tree do not recompile/regenerate shared precompiled headers concurrently with, or immediately after, a prior build step that already populated them. Prefer per-target/per-step isolated build directories, or explicit step ordering/dependencies guaranteeing the PCH is fully materialized (or intentionally disabled) before any second ninja invocation touches the same reference library.
historical_context: This exact signature (cc1plus 'not a PCH file' in openvino_reference during ARM64 cross-compilation) has now recurred 5 times since 2026-09-24, most recently on run 37382707255 (PR #38483) less than a day before this run, and previously on PR #38380, #38393, and #37942 - none of which touched GPU SDPA code, confirming this is an infra/build-config issue unrelated to the PR under test.
